text.en: Final blows and precision hits with Hawkmoon grant stacks of Paracausal Charge. The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage based on the number of stacks. Stowing Hawkmoon on the final round removes this bonus.

On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine <title refill [G_refill] />.

Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
<pve 21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66% />

Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.

Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| Stacks:
<pve PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736% />
<pvp PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509% />
